summary.text: Donald P. (Don) Wagner, a Republican Orange County Supervisor and former mayor of Irvine and member of the California Assembly, lost the November 3, 2026 election for secretary of state of California to Shirley Weber.
He proposed requiring voter ID at the polls and returning mail ballots by Election Day.

paragraphs.text: Wagner holds a B.A. in English from the University of California, Los Angeles, and a J.D. from the University of California, Hastings, and works as an attorney.
His candidate statement also lists service as a business owner.
He served in the California State Assembly from 2010 to 2016, representing District 70 from 2010 to 2012 and District 68 from 2012 to 2016, and as Mayor of Irvine from 2016 to 2019.
He has represented District 3 on the Orange County Board of Supervisors since 2019.
He received 33.5% of the vote to Shirley Weber's 66.5%, according to unofficial results reported by NBC News.
